messages.text: Morning all. Draft v2 of the Falcon diligence request list is in the deal folder. Sections: financial, commercial, legal, HR/benefits, IT, environmental. Elena, can you review before we send to Meridian's counsel?
Thanks Susan. Skimming now. First reaction: financial section needs more on working capital seasonality, and I want the fleet capex breakdown by asset class, not just a total.
Got it. I'll add monthly NWC for the last 36 months and capex split by tractors, trailers, and warehouse equipment. Want maintenance vs growth capex separated too?
Yes, definitely. Also ask for the lease schedule, both operating and finance leases. Under ASC 842 those will move the leverage math.

Quick compliance note on the list: keep the request wording generic. Nothing in it should reference our deal timeline or the announcement date. Also confirm the distribution is limited to wall-crossed people only.
Understood, Marcus. I've stripped the timeline language from the cover note. Distribution is the deal team plus Meridian's counsel through the data room, nobody else.
Agreed. Susan, please also double check the file name and metadata don't carry anything sensitive before it leaves the building.
Good call. Scrub the doc properties and tracked changes. I'd also like a copy of the final sent version for the Falcon restricted-list file.
Update: added legal section items on pending litigation, customer contract change-of-control clauses, and union agreements. Also added an IT item for TMS and routing software licenses.
Good. For commercial, add top 20 customer concentration with contract expiry dates and any volume commitments. And ask for churn data by lane over the last three years.
Adding both. Should I flag the customer concentration item as priority one? I figure it's the most likely to be slow to come back.
Yes, mark it priority one along with the lease schedule and the change-of-control provisions. Those drive the structure discussion.
v3 is up with all comments incorporated. 112 line items total, 14 flagged priority one. Metadata scrubbed. Marcus, ready for your look.
Reviewed. Wording is clean and nothing sensitive in the properties. Cleared to send via the data room. Please save the sent copy to the Falcon compliance folder.
Great, thanks both. Susan, send it over and note the time. We'll aim for a first-pass response from their side by end of next week.
